### switches / nodes / links 



::: {.r-stack .my-full}
![](/intro/texfig/nodes-links-switches--nodes--links.figure-1.svg){.fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=1 fig-alt="Diagram of computers connected by a network. Lines with arrowheads at both ends extend from the computers to a number of boxes (with a design of crossing lines with arrowheads). Later frames repeat the diagram and indicate the boxes are called ‘switches’; every participant (computers and switches) are called ‘nodes’; and the lines connecting them are called ‘links’ (regardless of whether implemented with wires or radio or whatever)."}

![](/intro/texfig/nodes-links-switches--nodes--links.figure-2.svg){.fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=2 fig-alt="Diagram of computers connected by a network. Lines with arrowheads at both ends extend from the computers to a number of boxes (with a design of crossing lines with arrowheads).
